title: Residential Painting in Hawthorne, FL | Home Painters
description: Residential painting in Hawthorne, FL for lakeside homes and newer SR-20 houses. Inside and out, own crews, written warranty, and a free itemized estimate.
h1: Residential Painting in Hawthorne, FL, Inside and Out
heroIntro: Whether your home is an older place near the lakes or a newer build off SR-20, we plan the repaint around how that particular house was built and how you live in it.

questions: How is an older Hawthorne home prepped differently from a new one?
Can you paint the inside and outside of my house in one project?
What warranty comes with a residential repaint?

sections.h2: Homes in Hawthorne are not one type
body: Residential painting in Hawthorne, FL covers a wide spread of houses. Near Lochloosa and Orange Lake you find older homes with wood trim, window casings, and porches that have been painted over many times. Along SR-20 the stock is newer, often with builder-grade finishes that were never meant to last. Each needs its own plan, and we price the plan rather than the square footage alone. Our Hawthorne location overview describes both neighborhoods in more detail.

sections.h2: Older lake-area homes: patience in the prep
body: On an older house the paint film is only as good as the layers under it. We scrape loose paint back to a firm edge, sand the transitions so they do not telegraph through, and test suspect wood with a moisture meter. Soft fascia, sill ends, and trim that have taken water are replaced, not covered. Bare wood is spot-primed before any topcoat.
Homes close to the water also see more mildew on shaded walls. We kill it during washing; primer laid over live growth simply does not hold. Our guide to mold on siding explains what we look for.

sections.h2: Newer SR-20 homes: building a real film
body: Newer houses usually need less repair and more product. The original builder coat tends to be thin and flat, so walls mark easily and exteriors chalk early. We wash, prime where the surface calls for it, and lay down two full coats of premium acrylic. Interior walls get a washable finish instead of the scuff-prone flat they shipped with.

sections.h2: Inside and outside on one schedule
body: Plenty of Hawthorne homeowners want both halves done. We usually schedule the outside of the house during the drier October-to-May window and slot the interior wherever it fits, since indoor work is not weather-bound. You stay home throughout; crews move and cover furniture and work room by room. For a closer look at the inside work, see our Hawthorne interior painting page.

sections.h2: Small exterior details that age a house fastest
body: On Hawthorne homes the trouble spots repeat: door frames where the bottom of the casing sits in splash-back, window sills that hold water after storms, porch posts and railings that take hands and sun, and shutters that were never primed on the back. We spend extra time on those pieces because they are where a repaint either holds or starts failing in the second summer. Shutters and doors can come off for a cleaner enamel finish when the hardware allows it.

sections.h2: What the estimate and warranty cover
body: The written estimate lists every surface included and excluded, the prep steps, the primer and topcoat by name, and the number of coats. On the outside of the house, our workmanship is backed in writing for as long as 10 years, separate from whatever the paint maker covers. Leftover paint is labelled by room or surface and left with you for future touch-ups. Learn more about our general approach on the residential painting service page.

faqs.q: How long does a full exterior take on a Hawthorne house?
faqs.a: Typically between three and seven working days, counted after washing is done and the walls have dried. Lake-area homes with more carpentry take the longest.

faqs.q: Will you replace rotted trim before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Rotted trim and fascia are replaced during prep. Painting over soft wood only hides the problem for a season.

faqs.q: Do you use low-VOC paint inside homes?
faqs.a: Low-VOC and eco-conscious products are available, and the product line chosen is named on your estimate.
